format.chart: 32-team double-elimination bracket with reseeding at every stage (Joe, 2026-10-23). Winners bracket stages of 16/8/4/2/1 series counting the opening round; losers bracket stages of 8/8/4/4/2/2/1/1, alternating survivor-only and drop-in rounds; grand final plus one reset series if the one-loss finalist wins the first final. 62 series total, 63 with the reset. At every stage the pool is reseeded by original tournament seed and paired highest vs lowest, second-highest vs second-lowest, so the top seed always draws the lowest-seeded survivor. See BRACKET.md.
format.home_pattern: 2-2-1-1-1, higher seed home first (Joe, 2026-10-23): Games 1-2 higher seed, 3-4 lower seed, 5 higher seed, 6 lower seed, 7 higher seed.
format.formation_gate: A stage forms only when every series feeding it is complete: Winners Round 2 and Losers Round 1 form when all 16 opening series finish; each later stage forms when its feeding stage finishes (plus the corresponding winners stage for losers drop-in stages). No pairing exists before its stage forms (Joe's reseeding rule, 2026-10-23).
format.final: Winners-bracket champion (undefeated) vs losers-bracket champion (one loss), best of 7; if the one-loss team wins, one reset series decides the championship.

stat_keying: Player stats are stored per (team, player_id). A player rostered by two teams has one line per team, never merged.

series.provenance: Played in Payoff Pitch as a standalone governed series on 2026-10-24 (FAC deck mode, version 2 pitcher cards, the pitcher addendum, manager traits, the fatigue fix layer from Game 3) and adopted into the tournament as R1-02 by Joe's ruling, the same adoption as R1-01. Box data is built from the series' saved state files (payoff-pitch-nationals/state_series_sf_wsh_g1..g5.json) by record_r1_02_pp_adoption.py. Field mapping: rolls holds the FAC flip history (card number and draw purpose), the Payoff Pitch equivalent of the dice record; final_grades is empty because Payoff Pitch has no letter grades, and pitcher fatigue end states are in fatigue_end_states; resolutions and n41 are null because those APBA counters do not exist in Payoff Pitch; batting sac is the states' single SH category, with sf and ibb null because the states do not split them; pitching lines carry hr allowed, which the states record, and hb null, which they do not record by pitcher.

carry.rotation_note: Each club used its five starters in posted order (SF: Mathewson, Hubbell, Marichal, Perry, Lincecum; WSH: Scherzer, Strasburg, Zimmermann, Gio Gonzalez, Livan Hernandez), so the cycle carries to the top in each club's next series.
carry.arms: Bullpen availability resets between rounds; no pitcher carries a restriction out of this series. Availability inside the series ran under the house outs convention and no reliever was ever capped.

series.label: Opening Round, Series 3
series.provenance: Played in Payoff Pitch as tournament series R1-03 on 2026-10-24 (FAC deck mode, version 2 pitcher cards, the pitcher addendum, manager traits for both clubs: Francona for Boston, Cash for Tampa Bay in tournament mode with the Opener refused under Joe's ruling that relievers do not start tournament games; the fatigue fix layer in both games) under Joe's ruling that the tournament is a Payoff Pitch tournament and APBA is closed. Games 1-2 are recorded here from the series' saved state files (payoff-pitch-rays/state_series_bos_tb_g1..g2.json) by record_r1_03_pp.py, following the R1-02 script's mechanism; the series is in progress, Boston leading 2-0, and later games append the same way. Tampa Bay plays in the host engine's 'PHA' guest slot, so the state files key the Rays as 'PHA'; those keys map to TB in the records. Field mapping: rolls holds the FAC flip history (card number and draw purpose), the Payoff Pitch equivalent of the dice record; final_grades is empty because Payoff Pitch has no letter grades, and pitcher fatigue end states are in fatigue_end_states, from the fix layer stored in both states; resolutions and n41 are null because those APBA counters do not exist in Payoff Pitch; batting sac is the states' single SH category, with sf and ibb null because the states do not split them; pitching lines carry hr allowed, which the states record, and hb null, which they do not record by pitcher. Availability ran under the house outs convention: caps_in and caps_out carry it in the archive's encoding (player_id: max outs next game, 0 would mean unavailable).

carry.rotation_note: Each club has used its first two starters in posted order (BOS: Pedro Martinez, Roger Clemens; TB: David Price, James Shields). Game 3 is at Tampa Bay: Cy Young vs Blake Snell. Full posted orders: BOS Martinez, Clemens, Young, Smoky Joe Wood, Lefty Grove; TB Price, Shields, Snell, Shane McClanahan, Scott Kazmir.
carry.arms: Availability inside the series runs under the house outs convention. J.P. Howell's Game 2 cap (3 outs, after 8 outs in Game 1) was honored exactly. Into Game 3 no pitcher is capped or unavailable: the Game 2 relief outs were Papelbon 5, McGee 4, Howell 3. Bullpen availability resets between rounds.
